title: Starfield
provenance: Reported by tomislav (highball#352, 2026-10-15), Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal: the game runs, with blocky shadows in some scenes (screenshots on the issue). The same reporter later found D3DMetal 4 (the Wine 11 engine r24) draws them the same and that Shadow Quality makes no difference (2026-10-17). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Runs on D3DMetal on the default engine (DirectX 12 only, so D3DMetal is the mode). Some shadows come out blocky with stair-stepped edges, seen inside a ship on an M1 Max. D3DMetal 4 (the Wine 11 engine r24) draws them the same, and a higher Shadow Quality does not change them.

knownIssues.symptom: Blocky, stair-stepped shadows in some scenes (M1 Max, D3DMetal 3 and 4)
knownIssues.fix: none known. Shadow Quality makes no difference
